wire_ops.value: List issues, optionally filtered by status and assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues by those attributes; use search_issues to find issues by text in the title or body, and get_issue for one issue by ID. Returns at most 50 issues unless limit is set. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

Search issues by case-insensitive text match against title and body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one issue by ID. Has no limit parameter and returns all matches. Comments are included by default; set include_comments to false for smaller responses.
Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Other values return an error.
Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true; set false for a smaller response.
Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true; set false for a smaller response.
